text: Come, sing something with me. El Parreño; I haven’t sung that for a long time.” Johnny laughed and hugged his guitar. “You not-a forget him?” He began teasing his strings. “Come!” He threw back his head, “Anoche-e-e—” “Anoche me confesse Con un padre carmelite, Y me dio penitencia Que besaras tu boquita.” (Last night I made confession With a Carmelite father, And he gave me absolution For the kisses you imprinted.) Johnny had almost every fault that a tenor can have.
